# simulator.setDebug

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Enable / Disable debug.

```lua
simulator.setDebug(command, value)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | yes | only "malloc" allowed |
| `value` | boolean | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
simulator.setDebug("malloc", true)
```
